audit.method: Read fresh private source/data and round-1 F1, inventoried numeric/cardinal catalog leaves and their producer sources, inspected the direct arithmetic/composed-value/count class, then reviewed authored patches. This is an authoring/static audit, not executed validation.
audit.boundary: Computed arithmetic, composed numeric payload descriptions, ages and observed/held/delivered counters are parameters. IDs, schema/version/status codes, input measurements/configuration, fixed frame schedules, mathematical coefficients and fixed ordinal cues remain literal where they are not computed result facts. No runtime model result is obtained by parsing English prose.

rows.disposition: Repaired. report fields and summed findings/reviewer counts share typed numeric summaries with raw gather payloads; changed findings preserve timing and template keys.
Already parameterized: direct/shared translator arithmetic, added participant and differences use computed params. Literal coefficients and the fixed three-view scenario are inputs.
No derived numeric result in model prose: HTTP status codes, route version and event identities are protocol/input labels; first/refresh ordinals are authored schedule cues.
Repaired. result counts and the moment label read the same held result arrays as the hand-written flow.
Repaired. receiver/order/delivery summaries derive from declared raw output values and order records; machine order/session IDs stay literal.
Repaired. pending/filed/routed counts derive from the raw finding set; blocking count uses routeOf. Renamed-field variant states its explicit 2-blocker outcome.
Repaired. queue record counts read the holding arrays used by the flow.
Repaired. pending command counts derive from the command record set; cmd_ identities remain protocol data.
Repaired. message timestamps and sweep ages use one numeric clock source, threshold/age parameters, and translated fresh/stale state words.
No computed numeric result copied into a catalog: command/receipt 7 identities and crash/retry schedule are authored inputs; second delivery is an ordinal cue.
No computed numeric figure in model prose: order IDs and performer/inflight settings describe protocol inputs and declared topology.
Repaired source/pending counts. Deadline arithmetic was already parameterized from timeToLive; order identities and fixed send-frame offsets are inputs.
Repaired. control-log entry counts derive from the exact held copy arrays; lost-copy token 3 remains a machine identity.
Repaired. input/output row counts derive from independent raw declared maps. Schema/version/row IDs remain protocol labels, and raw expected transformed rows remain independent literals.
Repaired. failure-count narration and router states receive counts from fold results; the configured failure limit remains a parameter.
Repaired. copyTotals reads raw declared values; default 4/3/12 and late-subscriber 4/3/9 use the same note template.
Repaired. close/copy totals derive from raw declared protocol records; record counts reuse the held entry arrays. Release/order IDs remain inputs.
No computed numeric result in model prose: command IDs and fixed deadline schedule are inputs; receipt vs result and late-reply states carry no copied arithmetic.
Repaired. held/released cardinalities use the exact declared holding arrays; computed next sequence is an evt_ machine identity and was kept as such.
Repaired. outside-write counts use the held write arrays. Command/attempt/write IDs and transaction identities remain protocol data.
No derived numerical result: status payloads, fixed subscription frames and declared listener topology are inputs; emissions are rendered by the shared builder.
No derived numerical figure: departure clock strings are reported inputs, not age/arithmetic results; replacement values append the error description.
Conservatively repaired numeric composition as well as arithmetic: raw budget percentages, composed rows and notes share numeric reports and translated state words.
Repaired the queued-photo cardinality from the declared raw photo set; photo names and upload ordering/timing remain inputs.
Draft numbers are machine identities and save timing is authored input; there is no reduced/computed numeric result in reader prose.
Part numbers are payload identities and the two callbacks are declared inputs/topology; no computed numeric result is copied into model prose.
Row numbers identify source payloads. N/E record kinds and hasValue flags are protocol values, with no numeric calculation duplicated in prose.
Repaired declared upload/result counts. Photo identities and fixed completion ordinals remain authored inputs.
Progress percentages are reported measurements passed through unchanged. Paint frames and scheduling offsets are authored inputs, not arithmetic results.
Repaired completion counters using declared completed-run milestones; configured count/delay and run/frame ordinals remain inputs.
Repaired held/replayed cardinalities from the raw replay letter groups, which now also construct their marble strings. Buffer capacity is a fixed configuration input.
Repaired used/absorbed failure counts and repeated-value count from error declarations and the raw output marble schedule; clock payloads are unchanged inputs.
Repaired. all expected balances and their narration share one numeric fact set; explicit changed amounts yield 18/13/22 and late 19 through the unchanged scan pipeline.
Raw numeric quotes already flow through marbleValue using actual numeric payloads. Memory capacity/refCount and subscription frames are inputs; no derived figure is copied in prose.
Raw numeric quotes are rendered from payloads; subscriber frames and shared-execution topology are inputs. No copied numerical reduction.
Status words and seed are protocol data. Fixed first/second subscriber ordinals are schedule cues, with no calculated numeric result in narration.
Press numbers identify input events; declared listener topology/subscription frames are inputs. There is no numeric reduction duplicated in prose.
Query/page numbers identify payloads and requests. Cancellation and frame schedule are declared inputs; there is no arithmetic result copied into locale text.
Ticks are raw machine symbols; close/subscription frames are declared inputs. Shared frame narration already parameterizes its numeric frame.
The startup/gap waits are already supplied from waits to operator presentation. TimeoutError seen count is asserted as data and is not hardcoded as a displayed numeric result.

Changed amounts 8/-5/9 yield explicit balances 18/13/22 and late 19, same note keys, original scan function and subscription schedule.
Changed budget reports 75/20 yield explicit raw rows and displayed note percentages while preserving the original run and marble schedule.
The same sweepState template displays explicit 10:07 / 7-minute fresh or stale outcomes under thresholds 20 and 5.
The retained late subscriber has explicit 4 orders / 3 subscribers / 9 copies and displays 4 orders, 9 copies through the same note template.
The retained renamed-field case displays explicit 2 blocking findings, counted from its declared blocking output values.
